mechanism_narrative: RETAIL_REC has been essentially flat at -16 to -17 percent for three consecutive weeks, indicating a stabilized floor in retail footfall. failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC moves by more than 3 percentage points in either direction over the next 4 weeks relative to the last 4-week mean, the flat-momentum hypothesis is rejected.
